CO-16.description: Claim or service lacks information or contains submission errors required for processing.
possible_causes: Missing required claim information
Incomplete patient or provider details
Invalid or missing procedure information
CO-16.recommended_action: Review the claim for missing or invalid information, verify all required fields and supporting documentation, correct the identified issues, and resubmit the claim.

CO-18.description: The submitted claim or service may be a duplicate of a previously processed claim.
possible_causes: The same claim was submitted more than once
A corrected claim was submitted without the appropriate indicator
The payer already processed an identical claim
CO-18.recommended_action: Check the claim history and verify whether the claim has already been processed. If the submission is a correction, follow the payer's corrected-claim procedure.

CO-11.description: The diagnosis code is inconsistent with the procedure performed.
possible_causes: Diagnosis code does not support medical necessity for the procedure
Incorrect diagnosis code was entered
Procedure code does not match the documented diagnosis
CO-11.recommended_action: Review the documented diagnosis and procedure codes for consistency, correct any coding errors, and resubmit with supporting documentation if needed.

CO-22.description: This care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits.
possible_causes: Patient has multiple insurance plans
Primary payer has not yet been billed
Coordination of benefits information is outdated or missing
CO-22.recommended_action: Verify the patient's coverage order, confirm which payer is primary, and resubmit to the correct payer or include primary payer's explanation of benefits.

CO-29.description: The time limit for filing the claim has expired.
possible_causes: Claim was submitted after the payer's filing deadline
Delay in initial submission or resubmission
Missing proof of timely filing
CO-29.recommended_action: Check the payer's timely filing limit and, if applicable, submit an appeal with proof of timely filing (e.g., original submission date or clearinghouse report).

CO-50.description: These are non-covered services because this is not deemed a medical necessity by the payer.
possible_causes: Documentation does not support medical necessity
Service is not covered under the patient's plan for the diagnosis given
Missing prior authorization for a service that required it
CO-50.recommended_action: Review medical necessity documentation, confirm payer coverage policy for the diagnosis/procedure combination, and consider an appeal with additional clinical documentation.

CO-72.description: The claim/service was denied because the payer determined that the information provided does not support the medical necessity of the service.
possible_causes: Insufficient clinical documentation to justify the service
Service is not considered medically necessary for the patient's condition
Prior authorization was not obtained for a service that required it
CO-72.recommended_action: Review the clinical documentation and the diagnosis-to-service relationship, confirm whether prior authorization was required, and correct or supplement the claim documentation before resubmission or appeal.
